text:
Anonymous post for another group member
— ending relationship situation — 

Hi everyone, 

My Israeli boyfriend and I decided to end our relationship after 7 years, which came as a surprise for me. 

I’m in my second year of my A5 visa and by the middle-end of July we will have our misrad hapnim appointment for extending my A5 visa for the third time. 

My life is in Israel now, and I have a part of me that wants to go to that appointment with him and fake we’re still together (he’s up for that), and I have another part of me that is scared of lying, and I’m also feeling that, emotionally, faking we’re still together after our recent break up and having to see each other like nothing happened, would be very hard and painful for me. 

The thing is that if we close our case, from what I understand, I’ll only have two weeks to leave the country, but my whole life is here now, and I don’t know how to start dealing with everything. 

I’m a freelance and have osek patur. 

If I decide not to renovate the visa, then is it enough that just one of us goes to misrad hapnim to let them know that we’re closing our file? 

If someone has gone through a similar situation I’ll be happy to read about your experiences. 

Did you also go to a visa renovation appointment even though you broke up recently? How did it go? 

What did you have to do in order to close up everything here and leave the country? Osek patur, health insurance, bank account, etc. 

Thank you in advance 🙏
